title: Light-theme argument transposed — light theme regresses on two rules
description: Arguments to dark-light-choose transposed, causing contrast regression in light theme. Username link jumps from near-body-text to washed-out tint. Also affects mobile/modal.scss:102 with opposite transposition.

title: Three more light-theme values silently changed during the mechanical sweep
description: Light-theme values incorrectly changed for .name (user.scss) and topic-list h3 (topic-post.scss), collapsing visual hierarchy and breaking mobile/desktop parity. Should restore original light values and derive dark side as 100-N.

title: One `scale-color($primary, …)` missed by the sweep
description: Badge notification color was not converted to dark-light-choose like the rest of the file. In dark theme, this makes the category topic count near-illegible.
